Use case: illustration-story. Asset: standalone wide 2:1 hero illustration for CircleU phone screen. Use the supplied image ONLY as exact character/style reference: one Pingu penguin with navy body, white face and tummy, single curved crest, small oval dark eyes, orange beak and feet, pale ice-blue scarf. Match its clean softly dimensional matte shading and mature friendly expression. No sketch lines, grain, photorealism or plastic shine. Brand palette navy, ice white, pale blue, cobalt accents, tiny warm peach/orange. Full bleed opaque illustration. No words, letters, logos, numbers, UI, buttons, frames or watermark. Keep anatomy consistent with flippers, no human hands. Render a single scene, not a collage. Design for small phone hero use with restrained details, generous margins around the entire character, and a quiet area for future native controls. Avoid the old composition of a penguin sitting by an ice arch, a lantern and sunset water.
Scene: a calm bright interior window seat, late morning. Pingu sits sideways on a broad pale-blue cushion in the LEFT third, body in three-quarter view, feet visible, one flipper lightly touching the scarf while looking thoughtfully out a tall round-corner window. No notebook or pencil. Outside is a very simple soft snowy hill and pale blue sky, not a dramatic landscape. A subtle peach shaft of daylight falls across the seat. RIGHT 45% is quiet pale ice-blue wall and spacious soft light, no props or pattern. Mood is reflective and composed, not sad or celebratory. Composition distinctly interior, close and architectural, not another icy cove. Output aspect ratio 2:1.
